_comment: Voiceover lines for oakridge-product-suite-motion.mp4. 'at' is when the line starts and 'until' is when the panel ends, both in seconds and both from the TIMELINE block in scene.js. A line must finish before 'until'. Aim for about 2.3 words per second.

lines.text: Every floor process, in one app, wired into one shared Google Sheet.
Home opens on what needs attention: boxes waiting on MAO, counts outside tolerance, and replen that's stalled.
Product Catalog. Scan any barcode for product details, hard-tag placement, and recent counts.
Counts. Anything off by more than two units, or five percent, stays flagged until it's recounted.
Consolidations. Count pieces as you pull them, batch lines into Holding, and log every closed box.
Receiving. Anything on the shelf but not yet in MAO stays on screen until it is.
Floor Stock. One line per style. Check the floor, pick the missing sizes, and restock.
Under the hood, every tap lands in one shared Google Sheet. No server, and no hosting bill.
Apps Script checks the access key on every request, before anything is read or written.
The Sheet keeps one tab per job, and leads can read and edit it directly.
Every device sees the same live data. Pull to refresh, and everyone's on the same numbers.
And it's never blocked by store Wi-Fi. Work keeps going offline, and syncs when you tap Update.
Oakridge Product Suite. Rebuilt for the floor.
